CREATE TABLE treatments (
  tenant_id uuid NOT NULL,
  doc jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(doc) = 'object'),
  id_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (id_kind IN ('objectid', 'string')),
  "_id" text NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> '_id') = 'string' THEN doc ->> '_id' END) STORED,
  created_at text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'created_at') = 'string' THEN doc ->> 'created_at' END) STORED,
  "eventType" text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'eventType') = 'string' THEN doc ->> 'eventType' END) STORED,
  identifier text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'identifier') = 'string' THEN doc ->> 'identifier' END) STORED,
  duration numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'duration') = 'number' THEN (doc ->> 'duration')::numeric END) STORED,
  date numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'date') = 'number' THEN (doc ->> 'date')::numeric END) STORED,
  "srvModified" numeric GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'srvModified') = 'number' THEN (doc ->> 'srvModified')::numeric END) STORED,
  "isValid" boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(doc -> 'isValid') = 'boolean' THEN (doc ->> 'isValid')::boolean END) STORED,
  CHECK ("_id" <> ''),
  CHECK (id_kind <> 'objectid' OR "_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{24}$'),
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id_kind, "_id")
)
CREATE INDEX treatments_tenant_created_at ON treatments (tenant_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX treatments_tenant_event_duration_created ON treatments (tenant_id, "eventType", duration, created_at)
CREATE INDEX treatments_tenant_event_created_identifier_date ON treatments (tenant_id, "eventType", created_at DESC, identifier DESC, date DESC)
CREATE INDEX treatments_tenant_history ON treatments (tenant_id, "srvModified", created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX treatments_identifier_unique ON treatments (tenant_id, identifier) WHERE identifier IS NOT NULL AND identifier <> ''
ALTER TABLE treatments ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE treatments FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
